ui:options.help: I have provided a description of the scope and terms of my relationship with the Applicant and my role in this transaction.
I have disclosed the types of products I am licensed and authorized to sell (e.g., fixed annuities, indexed annuities, variable annuities, life insurance, mutual funds).
I have stated whether I am authorized to sell products from one or more insurers and/or primarily contracted with a single insurer.
I have described the types and sources of cash and non-cash compensation I receive for the sale of this annuity.
I have informed the Applicant of their right to request more details regarding compensation.
If requested, I have provided a reasonable estimate of the compensation I will receive and indicated whether it is a one-time or recurring amount (including frequency and amount).
I have disclosed any material conflicts of interest related to this transaction.
